contradiction_resolution: No curated claim-level contradiction exists: contradicts_claim_ids is empty and data/claims.jsonl contains no opposing curve-theoretic claim. Canning-Larson Lemma 10.3 supplies the relative-canonical identification, Lemma 10.6 supplies the relevant degree calculation, and Lemma 10.10 excludes trigonal curves and smooth plane quintics from the balanced f_1=4 stratum. Riemann-Roch and Clifford theory then give h^0(L)=3. If L had a base point, L(-p) would be a base-point-free g^2_5 and hence would realize C as a smooth plane quintic, contradicting Lemma 10.10; therefore the nominal g^2_5 branch is empty and L is a base-point-free g^2_6. Bertini and the discriminant theory of Lanteri-Munoz verify that the non-reduced locus is a proper closed curve in |L|, while elementary configuration-space quotient theory gives the degree-720 etale S_6-torsor. Thus the finding is mathematically sound after narrowing to characteristic zero, but its principal reduced-support result duplicates FND-0134, and its torsor clause duplicates FND-0064. The only additional content is the standard statement that the complement is a discriminant curve, so FND-0140 should be merged into FND-0134 rather than independently promoted.

scope.base: geometric fibres over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero
scope.family: smooth degree-four Casnati-Ekedahl covers with relations bundle O(4) direct-sum O(5) and the stated weak relative-canonical normalization
scope.limitations: The audit does not extend the discriminant assertion to unspecified positive characteristic. Scheme-theoretic irreducibility or multiplicity of the discriminant is not asserted; it may be the dual curve together with components caused by ramification of the plane morphism.
scope.verified_conclusion: The normalization and degree formula give L isomorphic to omega_C(-D), of degree 6 and dimension 2. On the balanced stratum the plane-quintic alternative is excluded, so L is actually a base-point-free g^2_6 and its fixed part has degree zero. Its non-reduced members form a nonempty proper closed plane curve; the complementary reduced-support open is nonempty, dense, smooth, and non-closed. The ordered incidence over this open is a smooth finite etale S_6-torsor of degree 720.
